visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black hoodie, glasses, and a blue cap is seated in a professional gaming chair, holding a blue controller and looking intensely at a screen. In the background doorway, a woman in a white top and beige skirt stands calmly. Behind her, two other women's heads are visible peeking around the doorframe. The setting is a well-lit modern room with wooden floors and a desk equipped with gaming gear and a PlayStation neon logo. (2) The man exhibits a look of extreme surprise, gesturing wildly with his hands while still holding the controller. The woman in the doorway begins to step forward into the room. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the space. He briefly turns back to his desk as if in disbelief. (3) The primary woman approaches the man, presenting a white envelope and a retail box for a Nintendo Switch OLED console. Another woman follows closely behind her. The man, seemingly overwhelmed or in shock, places his hands on his head before jumping up from his chair. He rushes toward the door and swings it shut, isolating himself with the women and the gifts.
